name: Diandongbei-Large Flowery Miao
sweep_summary: Diandongbei-Large Flowery Miao is not in the catalog and the sweep produced exactly one title hit, Vogel (2023) 'Is There Foot Structure in Isolating Languages?', which Glottolog itself flags as a computerized language assignment from the word 'isolating'. Its abstract (OpenAlex, saved) says the two languages examined are Mandarin Chinese and Vietnamese; it is paywalled (DOI 10.1515/9783110730081-005; Unpaywall closed, no open copy found via OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, archive.org or Google Books). Relevance to this language: none; no first-hand stress statement for larg1235 was read.
